_note: Single source of truth for where everything sits on the panel decal. All coordinates are in PANEL PIXELS (1536 x 1024, exactly 3:2). The UI works in fractions of these, so the deck can be any size. Measured with tools/find-features.ps1 and tools/profile-sheets.ps1, then verified by compositing (tools/composite-test.ps1) and looking at the result - an image generator hits no exact coordinate, so the art is fitted to this table, never the other way round.

screen._note: The dark CRT glass inside the chrome bezel. Miniature visuals are drawn here.

fuelGlass._note: The glass barrel between the two chrome collars. A fuel decal is drawn to fill exactly this box, replacing the panel's own glass.

button._note: The Autorefill hole inside the octagonal nut. The red cap decal is drawn centred here.

knobChrome._note: Steel bezel. parts[] are tight alpha boxes measured from the sheet.

knobOrange._note: Painted orange bezel, no metal ring. Kept as a full alternative set.

fuel._note: 15 levels, index 0 = full, 14 = empty. Uniform grid, measured by profile.
